shloka_text: निवर्तमानः संहृष्टो रावणस्सुदुरात्मवान् । जह्रे पथि नरेन्द्रर्षिदेवगन्धर्वकन्यकाः ।। 7.24.1 ।।
transliteration: nivartamānaḥ saṃhṛṣṭo rāvaṇassudurātmavān | jahre pathi narendrarṣidevagandharvakanyakāḥ || 7.24.1 ||
translation: निवर्तमानः while returning, संहृष्टो greatly delighted, रावणस् Ravana, सुदुरात्मवान् the exceedingly wicked one, जह्रे seized, पथि on the way, नरेन्द्रर्षिदेवगन्धर्वकन्यकाः maidens of kings, sages, gods, and gandharvas.
explanation: While returning, the exceedingly wicked Ravana, greatly delighted, abducted maidens of kings, sages, gods, and gandharvas along his path.
comments: On his return Ravana carries off maidens of every race, filling the Pushpaka with weeping women who curse that he shall perish on account of a woman -- at Lanka his widowed sister, whose husband Vidyujjihva he had slain, laments, and Ravana consoles her -- he sets her brother Khara, with Dushana and fourteen thousand rakshasas, to guard the Dandaka forest, where Shurpanakha goes to dwell.

shloka_text: दर्शनीयां हि रक्षः स कन्यां स्त्रीं वापि पश्यति । हत्वा बन्धुजनं तस्या विमाने तां रुरोध ह ।। 7.24.2 ।।
transliteration: darśanīyāṃ hi rakṣaḥ sa kanyāṃ strīṃ vāpi paśyati | hatvā bandhujanaṃ tasyā vimāne tāṃ rurodha ha || 7.24.2 ||
translation: दर्शनीयां beautiful, हि indeed, रक्षः the demon, स he, कन्यां a maiden, स्त्रीं a woman, वापि or even, पश्यति sees, हत्वा having killed, बन्धुजनं the relatives, तस्या her, विमाने in the aerial car, तां her, रुरोध confined, ह indeed.
explanation: Whenever that demon saw a beautiful maiden or woman, he would kill her relatives and then confine her in his aerial car.

shloka_text: एवं पन्नगकन्याश्च राक्षसासुरमानुषीः । यक्षदानवकन्याश्च विमाने सो ऽध्यरोपयत् ।। 7.24.3 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ pannagakanyāśca rākṣasāsuramānuṣīḥ | yakṣadānavakanyāśca vimāne so 'dhyaropayat || 7.24.3 ||
translation: एवं thus, पन्नगकन्याश्च serpent-maidens and, राक्षसासुरमानुषीः demon, asura, and human women, यक्षदानवकन्याश्च yaksha and danava maidens and, विमाने in the aerial car, सो he, अध्यरोपयत् made to ascend.
explanation: In this manner, he also made serpent-maidens, demonesses, asura women, human women, and yaksha and danava maidens ascend into his aerial car.

shloka_text: ताश्च सर्वाः समं दुःखान्मुमुचुर्बाष्पजं जलम् । तुल्यमग्न्यर्चिषां तत्र शोकाग्निभयसम्भवम् ।। 7.24.4 ।।
transliteration: tāśca sarvāḥ samaṃ duḥkhānmumucurbāṣpajaṃ jalam | tulyamagnyarciṣāṃ tatra śokāgnibhayasambhavam || 7.24.4 ||
translation: ताश्च and they, सर्वाः all, समं together, दुःखान् from sorrow, मुमुचुर् shed, बाष्पजं tears, जलम् water, तुल्यम् resembling, अग्न्यर्चिषां flames of fire, तत्र there, शोकाग्निभयसम्भवम् arising from the fire of sorrow and fear.
explanation: All of them simultaneously shed tears born of sorrow, which resembled flames of fire, arising from the intense sorrow and fear they experienced.

shloka_text: ताभिः सर्वानवद्याभिर्नदीभिरिव सागरः । आपूरितं विमानं तद्भयशोकाशिवाश्रुभिः ।। 7.24.5 ।।
transliteration: tābhiḥ sarvānavadyābhirnadībhiriva sāgaraḥ | āpūritaṃ vimānaṃ tadbhayaśokāśivāśrubhiḥ || 7.24.5 ||
translation: ताभिः by them, सर्वानवद्याभिः by all blameless ones, नदीभिः by rivers, इव like, सागरः the ocean, आपूरितम् filled, विमानम् the aerial car, तत् that, भयशोकाशिवाश्रुभिः with tears of fear, sorrow, and inauspiciousness.
explanation: That aerial car was filled with the tears of fear, sorrow, and inauspiciousness from those blameless women, just as the ocean is filled by rivers.

shloka_text: नागगन्धर्वकन्याश्च महर्षितनयाश्च याः । दैत्यदानवकन्याश्च विमाने शतशो ऽरुदन् ।। 7.24.6 ।।
transliteration: nāgagandharvakanyāśca maharṣitanayāśca yāḥ | daityadānavakanyāśca vimāne śataśo 'rudan || 7.24.6 ||
translation: नागगन्धर्वकन्याः daughters of Nagas and Gandharvas, च and, महर्षितनयाः daughters of great sages, च and, याः who, दैत्यदानवकन्याः daughters of Daityas and Danavas, च and, विमाने in the aerial car, शतशः by hundreds, अरुदन् cried.
explanation: Hundreds of daughters of Nagas, Gandharvas, great sages, Daityas, and Danavas were weeping in the aerial car.

shloka_text: दीर्घकेश्यः सुचार्वङ्ग्यः पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाः । पीनस्तन्यस्तथा वज्रवेदिमध्यसमप्रभाः ।। 7.24.7 ।।
transliteration: dīrghakeśyaḥ sucārvaṅgyaḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanāḥ | pīnastanyastathā vajravedimadhyasamaprabhāḥ || 7.24.7 ||
translation: दीर्घकेश्यः with long hair, सुचार्वङ्ग्यः with very beautiful limbs, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाः with faces resembling the full moon, पीनस्तन्यः with full breasts, तथा and, वज्रवेदिमध्यसमप्रभाः with waists slender like the middle of a sacrificial altar.
explanation: These women possessed long hair, very beautiful limbs, faces like the full moon, full breasts, and waists slender like the middle of a sacrificial altar.

shloka_text: रथकूबरसङ्काशैः श्रोणिदेशैर्मनोहराः । स्त्रियः सुराङ्गनाप्रख्या निष्टप्तकनकप्रभाः ।। 7.24.8 ।।
transliteration: rathakūbarasaṅkāśaiḥ śroṇideśairmanoharāḥ | striyaḥ surāṅganāprakhyā niṣṭaptakanakaprabhāḥ || 7.24.8 ||
translation: रथकूबरसङ्काशैः with hips resembling the pole of a chariot, श्रोणिदेशैः with hip regions, मनोहराः charming, स्त्रियः women, सुराङ्गनाप्रख्याः resembling celestial nymphs, निष्टप्तकनकप्रभाः with the radiance of refined gold.
explanation: These charming women, resembling celestial nymphs, had hip regions broad like chariot poles and shone with the radiance of refined gold.

shloka_text: शोकदुःखभयत्रस्ता विह्वलाश्च सुमध्यमाः । तासां निश्वासवातेन सर्वतः सम्प्रदीपितम् ।। 7.24.9 ।।
transliteration: śokaduḥkhabhayatrastā vihvalāśca sumadhyamāḥ | tāsāṃ niśvāsavātena sarvataḥ sampradīpitam || 7.24.9 ||
translation: शोकदुःखभयत्रस्ताः distressed by sorrow, misery, and fear, विह्वलाः agitated, च and, सुमध्यमाः slender-waisted ones, तासाम् of them, निश्वासवातेन by the wind of their sighs, सर्वतः everywhere, सम्प्रदीपितम् was inflamed.
explanation: These slender-waisted women, distressed by sorrow, misery, and fear, were so agitated that the very atmosphere around them was inflamed by the wind of their sighs.

shloka_text: अग्निहोत्रमिवाभाति सन्निरुद्धाग्निपुष्पकम् । दशग्रीववशं प्राप्तास्तास्तु शोकाकुलाः स्त्रियः ।। 7.24.10 ।।
transliteration: agnihotramivābhāti sanniruddhāgnipuṣpakam | daśagrīvavaśaṃ prāptāstāstu śokākulāḥ striyaḥ || 7.24.10 ||
translation: अग्निहोत्रम् Agnihotra, इव like, आभाति appears, सन्निरुद्धाग्निपुष्पकम् with its fire and flowers restrained, दशग्रीववशम् the control of Daśagrīva, प्राप्ताः having attained, ताः those, तु indeed, शोकाकुलाः distressed with sorrow, स्त्रियः women.
explanation: Those women, having fallen under the sway of Daśagrīva, appeared like an Agnihotra ritual whose fire and flowers have been extinguished, overwhelmed by sorrow.

shloka_text: दीनवक्रेक्षणाः श्यामा मृग्यः सिंहवशा इव । काचिच्चिन्तयती तत्र किं नु मां भक्षयिष्यति ।। 7.24.11 ।।
transliteration: dīnavakrekṣaṇāḥ śyāmā mṛgyaḥ siṃhavaśā iva | kāciccintayatī tatra kiṃ nu māṃ bhakṣayiṣyati || 7.24.11 ||
translation: दीनवक्रेक्षणाः with sad, curved glances, श्यामाः young women, मृग्यः does, सिंहवशाः the control of a lion, इव like, काचित् some, चिन्तयती thinking, तत्र there, किम् what, नु indeed, माम् me, भक्षयिष्यति will he devour?
explanation: These young women, with their sad, curved glances, were like does under the control of a lion, and some among them wondered if he would devour them.

shloka_text: काचिद्दध्यौ सुदुःखार्ता अपि मां मारयेदयम् । इति मातृपितऽन्स्मृत्वा भर्तऽन्भ्रातऽंस्तथैव च । दुःखशोकसमाविष्टा विलेपुः सहिताः स्त्रियः ।। 7.24.12 ।।
transliteration: kāciddadhyau suduḥkhārtā api māṃ mārayedayam | iti mātṛpita'nsmṛtvā bharta'nbhrāta'ṃstathaiva ca | duḥkhaśokasamāviṣṭā vilepuḥ sahitāḥ striyaḥ || 7.24.12 ||
translation: काचित् some, दध्यौ thought, सुदुःखार्ता greatly distressed by sorrow, अपि perhaps, माम् me, मारयेत् might kill, अयम् this one, इति thus, मातृपितॄन् mothers and fathers, स्मृत्वा remembering, भर्तॄन् husbands, भ्रातॄन् brothers, तथैव च and similarly, दुःखशोकसमाविष्टाः overcome by pain and sorrow, विलेपुः lamented, सहिताः together, स्त्रियः women.
explanation: Some, greatly distressed, wondered if Rāvaṇa would kill them, and thus, remembering their mothers, fathers, husbands, and brothers, all the women together lamented, overcome by pain and sorrow.

shloka_text: कथं नु खलु मे पुत्रो भविष्यति मया विना । कथं माता कथं भ्राता निमग्नाः शोकसागरे ।। 7.24.13 ।। ।
transliteration: kathaṃ nu khalu me putro bhaviṣyati mayā vinā | kathaṃ mātā kathaṃ bhrātā nimagnāḥ śokasāgare || 7.24.13 || |
translation: कथम् how, नु indeed, खलु certainly, मे my, पुत्रः son, भविष्यति will be, मया without me, विना without, कथम् how, माता mother, कथम् how, भ्राता brother, निमग्नाः immersed, शोकसागरे in the ocean of sorrow.
explanation: They lamented, "How will my son fare without me? How will my mother and brother, immersed in an ocean of sorrow, endure?"

shloka_text: हा कथं नु करिष्यामि भर्तुस्तस्मादहं विना । मृत्यो प्रसादयामि त्वां नय मां दुःखभागिनीम् ।। 7.24.14 ।।
transliteration: hā kathaṃ nu kariṣyāmi bhartustasmādahaṃ vinā | mṛtyo prasādayāmi tvāṃ naya māṃ duḥkhabhāginīm || 7.24.14 ||
translation: हा alas, कथम् how, नु indeed, करिष्यामि shall I do/live, भर्तुः husband, तस्मात् from that, अहम् I, विना without, मृत्यो O Death, प्रसादयामि I propitiate, त्वाम् you, नय take, माम् me, दुःखभागिनीम् the one sharing sorrow.
explanation: "Alas, how shall I live without that husband? O Death, I implore you, take me, who am burdened with such sorrow."

shloka_text: किन्नु तद्दुष्कृतं कर्म पुरा देहान्तरे कृतम् ।। 7.24.15 ।।
transliteration: kinnu tadduṣkṛtaṃ karma purā dehāntare kṛtam || 7.24.15 ||
translation: किन्नु what indeed, तत् that, दुष्कृतं evil, कर्म deed, पुरा previously, देहान्तरे in another body, कृतम् done,
explanation: What evil deed did we indeed commit in a previous life?

shloka_text: एवं स्म दुःखिताः सर्वाः पतिताः शोकसागरे । न खल्विदानीं पश्यामो दुःखस्यास्यान्तमात्मनः ।। 7.24.16 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ sma duḥkhitāḥ sarvāḥ patitāḥ śokasāgare | na khalvidānīṃ paśyāmo duḥkhasyāsyāntamātmanaḥ || 7.24.16 ||
translation: एवं thus, स्म indeed, दुःखिताः distressed, सर्वाः all, पतिताः fallen, शोकसागरे into the ocean of sorrow, न not, खलु indeed, इदानीं now, पश्यामो we see, दुःखस्य of sorrow, अस्य this, अन्तम् end, आत्मनः of ourselves,
explanation: Thus, all of us are distressed and fallen into an ocean of sorrow, and we indeed see no end to this suffering of ours now.

shloka_text: अहो धिङ्मानुषं लोकं नास्ति खल्वधमः परः । यद्दुर्बला बलवता भर्तारो रावणेन नः ।। 7.24.17 ।।
transliteration: aho dhiṅmānuṣaṃ lokaṃ nāsti khalvadhamaḥ paraḥ | yaddurbalā balavatā bhartāro rāvaṇena naḥ || 7.24.17 ||
translation: अहो alas, धिङ् shame upon, मानुषं human, लोकं world, न not, अस्ति there is, खलु indeed, अधमः lower, परः than, यत् that, दुर्बला weak, बलवता by the strong, भर्तारो husbands, रावणेन by Ravana, नः our,
explanation: Alas, shame upon the human race, for there is indeed nothing lower than this, that our husbands are weak before the mighty Ravana.

shloka_text: सूर्येणोदयता काले नक्षत्राणीव नाशिताः । अहो सुबलवद्रक्षो वधोपायेषु युज्यते ।। 7.24.18 ।।
transliteration: sūryeṇodayatā kāle nakṣatrāṇīva nāśitāḥ | aho subalavadrakṣo vadhopāyeṣu yujyate || 7.24.18 ||
translation: सूर्येण by the sun, उदयता rising, काले at the time, नक्षत्राणीव as if stars, नाशिताः destroyed, अहो alas, सुबलवत् very strong, रक्षो demon, वधोपायेषु in means of killing, युज्यते is engaged,
explanation: Just as stars are destroyed by the rising sun, so too are our husbands, and alas, the very strong demon Ravana is engaged in means of killing.

shloka_text: अहो दुर्वृत्तमास्थाय नात्मानं वैजुगुप्सते । सर्वथा सदृशस्तावद्विक्रमो ऽस्य दुरात्मनः ।। 7.24.19 ।।
transliteration: aho durvṛttamāsthāya nātmānaṃ vaijugupsate | sarvathā sadṛśastāvadvikramo 'sya durātmanaḥ || 7.24.19 ||
translation: अहो alas, दुर्वृत्तम् evil conduct, आस्थाय having resorted to, न not, आत्मानं himself, वै indeed, जुगुप्सते he despises, सर्वथा in every way, सदृशः fitting, तावत् indeed, विक्रमः valor, अस्य his, दुरात्मनः of the wicked one,
explanation: Alas, having resorted to evil conduct, he indeed does not despise himself, and in every way, the valor of this wicked one is indeed fitting.

shloka_text: इदं त्वसदृशं कर्म परदाराभिमर्शनम् । यस्मादेष परक्यासु रमते राक्षसाधमः ।। 7.24.20 ।।
transliteration: idaṃ tvasadṛśaṃ karma paradārābhimarśanam | yasmādeṣa parakyāsu ramate rākṣasādhamaḥ || 7.24.20 ||
translation: इदं this, तु indeed, असदृशं unseemly, कर्म act, परदाराभिमर्शनम् molesting other's wives, यस्मात् because, एष this (one), परक्यासु in other's wives, रमते delights, राक्षसाधमः vilest of Rākṣasas,
explanation: This act of molesting other men's wives is indeed unseemly, because this vilest of Rākṣasas delights in other women.

shloka_text: तस्माद्वै स्त्रीकृतेनैव प्राप्स्यते दुर्मतिर्वधम् । सतीभिर्वरनारीभिरेवं वाक्ये ऽभ्युदीरिते ।। 7.24.21 ।।
transliteration: tasmādvai strīkṛtenaiva prāpsyate durmatirvadham | satībhirvaranārībhirevaṃ vākye 'bhyudīrite || 7.24.21 ||
translation: तस्मात् therefore, वै indeed, स्त्रीकृतेन by a woman, एव only, प्राप्स्यते will obtain, दुर्मतिः the evil-minded one, वधम् death, सतीभिः by chaste women, वरनारीभिः by excellent women, एवं thus, वाक्ये when the words, अभ्युदीरिते were uttered,
explanation: Therefore, this evil-minded one will indeed meet his death only on account of a woman, thus spoke the chaste and excellent women.

shloka_text: नेदुर्दुन्दुभयः खस्थाः पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात च । शप्तः स्त्रीभिः स तु समं हतौजा इव निष्प्रभः ।। 7.24.22 ।।
transliteration: nedurdundubhayaḥ khasthāḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca | śaptaḥ strībhiḥ sa tu samaṃ hataujā iva niṣprabhaḥ || 7.24.22 ||
translation: नेदुः resounded, दुन्दुभयः drums, खस्थाः celestial, पुष्पवृष्टिः shower of flowers, पपात fell, च and, शप्तः cursed, स्त्रीभिः by the women, सः he, तु indeed, समं at the same time, हतौजाः one whose vigor is lost, इव as if, निष्प्रभः lusterless,
explanation: Celestial drums resounded and a shower of flowers fell, and he, cursed by the women, became lusterless as if his vigor was lost.

shloka_text: पतिव्रताभिः साध्वीभिर्बभूव विमना इव । एवं विलपितं तासां शृण्वन्राक्षसपुङ्गवः । प्रविवेश पुरीं लङ्कां पूज्यमानो निशाचरैः ।। 7.24.23 ।।
transliteration: pativratābhiḥ sādhvībhirbabhūva vimanā iva | evaṃ vilapitaṃ tāsāṃ śṛṇvanrākṣasapuṅgavaḥ | praviveśa purīṃ laṅkāṃ pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ || 7.24.23 ||
translation: पतिव्रताभिः by chaste wives, साध्वीभिः by virtuous women, बभूव became, विमनाः disheartened, इव as if, एवं thus, विलपितं lamentation, तासां of those (women), शृण्वन् listening, राक्षसपुङ्गवः the foremost of Rākṣasas, प्रविवेश entered, पुरीं the city, लङ्कां Lanka, पूज्यमानः being honored, निशाचरैः by the night-wanderers,
explanation: He became as if disheartened by the chaste and virtuous women; listening to their lamentation, the foremost of Rākṣasas entered the city of Lanka, being honored by the night-wanderers.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे घोरा राक्षसी कामरूपिणी । सहसा पतिता भूमौ भगिनी रावणस्य सा ।। 7.24.24 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare ghorā rākṣasī kāmarūpiṇī | sahasā patitā bhūmau bhaginī rāvaṇasya sā || 7.24.24 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, घोरा terrible, राक्षसी Rākṣasī, कामरूपिणी assuming any form at will, सहसा suddenly, पतिता fell, भूमौ on the ground, भगिनी sister, रावणस्य of Rāvaṇa, सा she,
explanation: In the meantime, that terrible Rākṣasī, Rāvaṇa's sister, who could assume any form at will, suddenly fell on the ground.

shloka_text: तां स्वसारं समुत्थाप्य रावणः परिसान्त्वयन् । अब्रवीत्किमिदं भद्रे वक्तुकामा ऽसि मे द्रुतम् ।। 7.24.25 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ svasāraṃ samutthāpya rāvaṇaḥ parisāntvayan | abravītkimidaṃ bhadre vaktukāmā 'si me drutam || 7.24.25 ||
translation: तां her, स्वसारं sister, समुत्थाप्य having raised up, रावणः Ravana, परिसान्त्वयन् consoling, अब्रवीत् said, किम् what, इदं this, भद्रे O gentle one, वक्तुकामा desirous of speaking, असि you are, मे to me, द्रुतम् quickly,
explanation: Ravana, having raised his sister up and consoled her, asked her what she quickly wished to tell him.

shloka_text: सा बाष्पपरिरुद्धाक्षी रक्ताक्षी वाक्यमब्रवीत् । कृता ऽस्मि विधवा राजंस्त्वया बलवता बलात् ।। 7.24.26 ।।
transliteration: sā bāṣpapariruddhākṣī raktākṣī vākyamabravīt | kṛtā 'smi vidhavā rājaṃstvayā balavatā balāt || 7.24.26 ||
translation: सा she, बाष्पपरिरुद्धाक्षी with eyes obstructed by tears, रक्ताक्षी with red eyes, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, कृता made, अस्मि I am, विधवा a widow, राजन् O king, त्वया by you, बलवता powerful one, बलात् by force,
explanation: With her eyes red and obstructed by tears, she spoke, saying, "O king, I have been forcibly made a widow by you, the powerful one."

shloka_text: एते राजंस्त्वया वीरा दैत्या विनिहता रणे । कालकेया इति ख्याताः सहस्राणि चतुर्दश ।। 7.24.27 ।।
transliteration: ete rājaṃstvayā vīrā daityā vinihatā raṇe | kālakeyā iti khyātāḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa || 7.24.27 ||
translation: एते these, राजन् O king, त्वया by you, वीराः brave ones, दैत्याः Daityas, विनिहताः killed, रणे in battle, कालकेयाः Kalakeyas, इति thus, ख्याताः known, सहस्राणि thousands, चतुर्दश fourteen,
explanation: O king, these brave Daityas, known as the fourteen thousand Kalakeyas, were killed by you in battle.

shloka_text: प्राणेभ्यो ऽपि गरीयान्मे तत्र भर्ता महाबलः ।। 7.24.28 ।।
transliteration: prāṇebhyo 'pi garīyānme tatra bhartā mahābalaḥ || 7.24.28 ||
translation: प्राणेभ्यः than life, अपि even, गरीयान् dearer, मे to me, तत्र there, भर्ता husband, महाबलः mighty-armed,
explanation: Among them was my mighty-armed husband, who was dearer to me even than my own life.

shloka_text: सो ऽपि त्वया हतस्तात रिपुणा भ्रातृगृध्नुना । त्वया ऽस्मि निहता राजन्स्वयमेव हि बन्धुना ।। 7.24.29 ।।
transliteration: so 'pi tvayā hatastāta ripuṇā bhrātṛgṛdhnunā | tvayā 'smi nihatā rājansvayameva hi bandhunā || 7.24.29 ||
translation: सः he, अपि even, त्वया by you, हतः killed, तात O dear one, रिपुणा by an enemy, भ्रातृगृध्नुना hostile to kinsmen, त्वया by you, अस्मि I am, निहता killed, राजन् O king, स्वयम् myself, एव indeed, हि certainly, बन्धुना by a kinsman,
explanation: O dear one, even he was killed by you, an enemy hostile to your own kin; O king, I myself have certainly been destroyed by you, my own kinsman.

shloka_text: राजन्वैधव्यशब्दं च भोक्ष्यामि त्वत्कृते ह्यहम् । ननु नाम त्वया रक्ष्यो जामाता समरेष्वपि । स त्वया निहतो युद्धे स्वयमेव न लज्जसे ।। 7.24.30 ।।
transliteration: rājanvaidhavyaśabdaṃ ca bhokṣyāmi tvatkṛte hyaham | nanu nāma tvayā rakṣyo jāmātā samareṣvapi | sa tvayā nihato yuddhe svayameva na lajjase || 7.24.30 ||
translation: राजन् Rajan (O King), वैधव्यशब्दं vaidhavyaśabdaṃ (the word 'widowhood'), च ca (and), भोक्ष्यामि bhokṣyāmi (I shall experience), त्वत्कृते tvatkṛte (because of you), हि hi (indeed), अहम् aham (I); ननु nanu (surely), नाम nāma (indeed), त्वया tvayā (by you), रक्ष्यो rakṣyo (to be protected), जामाता jāmātā (a son-in-law), समरेष्वपि samareṣvapi (even in battles); स sa (he), त्वया tvayā (by you), निहतो nihato (was killed), युद्धे yuddhe (in battle), स्वयमेव svayameva (by yourself), न na (not), लज्जसे lajjase (are you ashamed).
explanation: The speaker laments that she will become a widow because of the king's actions, questioning how he could kill his own son-in-law in battle, whom he was supposed to protect, without any shame.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवो भगिन्या क्रोशमानया । अब्रवीत्सान्त्वयित्वा तां सामपूर्वमिदं वचः ।। 7.24.31 ।।
transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvo bhaginyā krośamānayā | abravītsāntvayitvā tāṃ sāmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ || 7.24.31 ||
translation: एवम् evam (thus), उक्तो ukto (addressed), दशग्रीवो daśagrīvo (Dashagriva, Ravana), भगिन्या bhaginyā (by his sister), क्रोशमानया krośamānayā (who was wailing), अब्रवीत् abravīt (spoke), सान्त्वयित्वा sāntvayitvā (having consoled), तां tāṃ (her), सामपूर्वम् sāmapūrvam (with soothing words), इदं idaṃ (this), वचः vacaḥ (speech).
explanation: Thus addressed by his wailing sister, Ravana consoled her and spoke these soothing words.

shloka_text: अलं वत्से रुदित्वा ते न भेतव्यं च सर्वशः । दानमानप्रसादैस्त्वां तोषयिष्यामि यत्नतः ।। 7.24.32 ।।
transliteration: alaṃ vatse ruditvā te na bhetavyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | dānamānaprasādaistvāṃ toṣayiṣyāmi yatnataḥ || 7.24.32 ||
translation: अलम् alam (enough), वत्से vatse (O child), रुदित्वा ruditvā (by weeping), ते te (for you); न na (not), भेतव्यं bhetavyaṃ (to be feared), च ca (and), सर्वशः sarvaśaḥ (in any way); दानमानप्रसादैः dānamānaprasādaiḥ (with gifts, honors, and favors), त्वां tvāṃ (you), तोषयिष्यामि toṣayiṣyāmi (I shall satisfy), यत्नतः yatnataḥ (with effort).
explanation: Ravana told her to stop weeping and not to fear, promising to satisfy her with great effort through gifts, honors, and favors.

shloka_text: युद्धप्रमत्तो व्याक्षिप्तो जयाकाङ्क्षी क्षिपञ्छरान् । नावगच्छामि युद्धेषु स्वान्परान्वाप्यहं शुभे ।। 7.24.33 ।।
transliteration: yuddhapramatto vyākṣipto jayākāṅkṣī kṣipañcharān | nāvagacchāmi yuddheṣu svānparānvāpyahaṃ śubhe || 7.24.33 ||
translation: युद्धप्रमत्तो yuddhapramatto (intoxicated by battle), व्याक्षिप्तो vyākṣipto (distracted), जयाकाङ्क्षी jayākāṅkṣī (desiring victory), क्षिपञ्छरान् kṣipañcharān (hurling arrows), न na (not), अवगच्छामि avagacchāmi (I distinguish), युद्धेषु yuddheṣu (in battles), स्वान् svān (my own people), परान् parānvā (or enemies), अपि api (even), अहं ahaṃ (I), शुभे śubhe (O auspicious one).
explanation: Ravana explained that in the heat of battle, intoxicated and distracted by the desire for victory while showering arrows, he cannot distinguish between his own people and enemies.

shloka_text: जामातरं न जाने स्म प्रहरन्युद्धदुर्मदः । तेनासौ निहतः सङ्ख्ये मया भर्ता तव स्वसः ।। 7.24.34 ।।
transliteration: jāmātaraṃ na jāne sma praharanyuddhadurmadaḥ | tenāsau nihataḥ saṅkhye mayā bhartā tava svasaḥ || 7.24.34 ||
translation: जामातरं jāmātaraṃ (the son-in-law), न na (not), जाने jāne (I knew), स्म sma (indeed), प्रहरन् praharan (while striking), युद्धदुर्मदः yuddhadurmadaḥ (intoxicated by the frenzy of battle); तेन tena (therefore), असौ asau (he), निहतः nihataḥ (was killed), सङ्ख्ये saṅkhye (in battle), मया mayā (by me), भर्ता bhartā (the husband), तव tava (your), स्वसः svasaḥ (O sister).
explanation: Ravana confessed that, maddened by the battle, he did not recognize his son-in-law while striking and thus inadvertently killed her husband in the conflict.

shloka_text: अस्मिन्काले तु यत्प्राप्तं तत्करिष्यामि ते हितम् । भ्रातुरैश्वर्ययुक्तस्य खरस्य वस पार्श्वतः ।। 7.24.35 ।।
transliteration: asminkāle tu yatprāptaṃ tatkariṣyāmi te hitam | bhrāturaiśvaryayuktasya kharasya vasa pārśvataḥ || 7.24.35 ||
translation: अस्मिन्काले in this time, तु indeed, यत्प्राप्तं whatever is appropriate, तत्करिष्यामि that I will do, ते for you, हितम् beneficial. भ्रातुः of the brother, ऐश्वर्ययुक्तस्य endowed with power, खरस्य of Khara, वस dwell, पार्श्वतः by the side.
explanation: At this time, I will do what is beneficial for you; dwell by the side of your brother Khara, who is endowed with power.

shloka_text: चतुर्दशानां भ्राता ते सहस्राणां भविष्यति । प्रभुः प्रयाणे दाने च राक्षसानां महाबलः ।। 7.24.36 ।।
transliteration: caturdaśānāṃ bhrātā te sahasrāṇāṃ bhaviṣyati | prabhuḥ prayāṇe dāne ca rākṣasānāṃ mahābalaḥ || 7.24.36 ||
translation: चतुर्दशानां of fourteen, सहस्राणां of thousands, ते your, भ्राता brother, भविष्यति will be. प्रभुः the lord, प्रयाणे in marching, दाने in giving, च and, राक्षसानां of rakshasas, महाबलः very powerful.
explanation: Your brother will be the lord of fourteen thousand very powerful Rakshasas, commanding them in expeditions and bestowing gifts.

shloka_text: तत्र मातृष्वसेयस्ते भ्राता ऽयं वै खरः प्रभुः । भविष्यति तवादेशं सदा कुर्वन्निशाचरः ।। 7.24.37 ।।
transliteration: tatra mātṛṣvaseyaste bhrātā 'yaṃ vai kharaḥ prabhuḥ | bhaviṣyati tavādeśaṃ sadā kurvanniśācaraḥ || 7.24.37 ||
translation: तत्र there, ते your, मातृष्वसेयः cousin (son of mother's sister), अयं this, वै indeed, भ्राता brother, खरः Khara, प्रभुः the lord, भविष्यति will be, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, सदा always, तवादेशं your command, कुर्वन् executing.
explanation: There, your cousin and brother Khara, the lordly night-wanderer, will always execute your commands.

shloka_text: शीघ्रं गच्छत्वयं वीरो दण्डकान्परिरक्षितुम् । दूषणो ऽस्य बलाध्यक्षो भविष्यति महाबलः ।। 7.24.38 ।।
transliteration: śīghraṃ gacchatvayaṃ vīro daṇḍakānparirakṣitum | dūṣaṇo 'sya balādhyakṣo bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ || 7.24.38 ||
translation: शीघ्रं quickly, अयं this, वीरः hero, दण्डकान् to the Dandaka forest, परिरक्षितुम् to protect, गच्छतु let him go. दूषणः Dushana, अस्य his, बलाध्यक्षः commander of forces, भविष्यति will be, महाबलः very powerful.
explanation: Let this hero quickly go to protect the Dandaka forest, and the very powerful Dushana will be his commander of forces.

shloka_text: तत्र ते वचनं शूरः करिष्यति सदा खरः । रक्षसां कामरूपाणां प्रभुरेष भविष्यति ।। 7.24.39 ।।
transliteration: tatra te vacanaṃ śūraḥ kariṣyati sadā kharaḥ | rakṣasāṃ kāmarūpāṇāṃ prabhureṣa bhaviṣyati || 7.24.39 ||
translation: तत्र there, शूरः the brave, खरः Khara, ते your, वचनं command, सदा always, करिष्यति will execute. एषः this one, कामरूपाणां who can change form at will, रक्षसां of rakshasas, प्रभुः the lord, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: There, the brave Khara will always execute your commands, and he will be the lord of the Rakshasas who can change their form at will.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा दशग्रीवः सैन्यमस्यादिदेश ह । चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसां वीर्यशालिनाम् ।। 7.24.40 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā daśagrīvaḥ sainyamasyādideśa ha | caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasāṃ vīryaśālinām || 7.24.40 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), सैन्यम् army, अस्य to him (Khara), आदिदेश ordered, ह indeed, चतुर्दश fourteen, सहस्राणि thousands, रक्षसाम् of Rakshasas, वीर्यशालिनाम् valorous.
explanation: Having spoken thus, Dashagriva (Ravana) indeed ordered an army of fourteen thousand valorous Rakshasas for Khara.

shloka_text: स तैः परिवृतस्सर्वै राक्षसैर्घोरदर्शनैः । आगच्छत खरः शीघ्रं दण्डकानकुतोभयः ।। 7.24.41 ।।
transliteration: sa taiḥ parivṛtassarvai rākṣasairghoradarśanaiḥ | āgacchata kharaḥ śīghraṃ daṇḍakānakutobhayaḥ || 7.24.41 ||
translation: सः he (Khara), तैः by them, परिवृतः surrounded, सर्वैः all, राक्षसैः by Rakshasas, घोरदर्शनैः of terrible appearance, आगच्छत came, खरः Khara, शीघ्रम् quickly, दण्डकान् to Dandaka forest, अकुतोभयः fearless.
explanation: Surrounded by all those Rakshasas of terrible appearance, Khara quickly and fearlessly came to the Dandaka forest.

shloka_text: स तत्र कारयामास राज्यं निहतकण्टकम् । सा च शूर्पणखा तत्र न्यवसद्दण्डकावने ।। 7.24.42 ।।
transliteration: sa tatra kārayāmāsa rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam | sā ca śūrpaṇakhā tatra nyavasaddaṇḍakāvane || 7.24.42 ||
translation: सः he (Khara), तत्र there, कारयामास established, राज्यम् kingdom, निहतकण्टकम् free from enemies, सा she, च and, शूर्पणखा Shurpanakha, तत्र there, न्यवसत् resided, दण्डकावने in the Dandaka forest.
explanation: Khara established a kingdom free from enemies there, and Shurpanakha also resided in the Dandaka forest. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुर्विंशः सर्गः ।। 24 ।। Thus ends the twenty-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
